about: Where each agent's hook contract was checked (24.0 reads no session store). Gate: scripts/catalog_check.py. Weekly sentinel: scripts/vendor_drift.py.

hooks.note: Every Pulse entry runs async: true — an async hook cannot block or decide ("Run hooks in the background"). PostToolUse replaces PreToolUse for activity; PostToolUseFailure (after a tool call fails; output cannot change the outcome) is activity too. PermissionDenied is not installed: its hookSpecificOutput.retry can change what the model does. PermissionRequest AskUserQuestion reads tool_input.questions[0].question; ExitPlanMode reads tool_input.plan.

hooks.json shares Claude's nested shape and honours async (SessionEnd always runs synchronously, capped at 3 s). PermissionRequest is never installed: it fires before Codex's own auto-review. The legacy notify argv (agent-turn-complete) stays. PostToolUse is installed async (engine/discovery.rs: only SessionEnd is forced synchronous; an async handler's output is never read) — the per-tool activity that makes a stall meaningful.

cursor.com was unreachable from the build environment on 2026-09-29; event names and payload fields (conversation_id, workspace_roots, transcript_path, status) were cross-checked against third-party typed bindings (pkg.go.dev/github.com/Checkmarx/ast-cx-hooks/cursor, github.com/speakeasy-api/gram server/design/hooks). beforeSubmitPrompt can stop a prompt and is not installed. Re-read the docs on a machine that can reach them.
Extension events are notifications when the handler returns nothing; ui_prompt_start/ui_prompt_end are Pi's own report of a blocking user-facing prompt.

Exit 0 with empty stdout passes every event; only exit 2 or a decision in stdout blocks. Notification is observability only. Hooks run with a sanitized environment, so terminal handles may be missing. AfterTool is observe-only for Pulse (it prints nothing, so no decision, no continue:false, no tailToolCallRequest): the tool ran, which answers a ToolPermission raised for it.

camelCase event names select the camelCase payload. notification is fire-and-forget; agentStop/sessionStart outputs are ignored when stdout is empty. agent_idle/agent_completed describe background subagents and are not read as the session's turn. postToolUse / postToolUseFailure: empty output keeps the original result ("Return {} or empty output"); only exit 2 on postToolUseFailure adds context, and Pulse exits 0 — the tool ran, which answers a permission_prompt.
A legacy plugin module: every named export is a plugin function. Only the event hook is used; it never throws and never awaits the child it spawns.
